convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'RenkoLineBreak' custom indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The RenkoLineBreak indicator buffer structure and calculation logic are external and must be replicated in Python. Money management includes both fixed lot and fixed percent modes via MoneyFixedLot.mqh.

derived_values.name: box_size from InpMinBoxSize input
derived_values.used_by: RenkoLineBreak indicator and trigger price calculations

derived_values.name: rsi_vshift from InpRsiVShift input
derived_values.used_by: Entry and exit RSI threshold calculations (50 ± rsi_vshift)

derived_values.name: RLB trend state derived from buffer 2 values
derived_values.formula: rlb[1]>0 && rlb[0]<0 → TO_UP; rlb[1]>0 && rlb[0]>=0 → UP; rlb[1]<0 && rlb[0]>0 → TO_DOWN; rlb[1]<0 && rlb[0]<=0 → DOWN
derived_values.used_by: CheckOrder and CheckPosition for entry and exit decisions

params.calculation: For BUY_STOP: lowest of last 3 bars low minus indent; For SELL_STOP: highest of last 3 bars high plus indent plus spread
InpTakeProfit * _Point added to open (buy) or subtracted from open (sell)

other_exits: Close BUY position when RenkoLineBreak trend changes to TO_DOWN or RSI > 50 + rsi_vshift
Close SELL position when RenkoLineBreak trend changes to TO_UP or RSI < 50 - rsi_vshift (and RSI >= 0)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM_MODE enum exists (FIXED_LOT, FIXED_PERCENT) and MoneyFixedLot.mqh is included, but only InpVolume (fixed lot) is actively used in trade execution. Fixed percent mode is declared but not implemented in OnTick flow.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a custom RenkoLineBreak indicator loaded via iCustom with buffer index 2 for trend determination. Trend is derived from 3 consecutive buffer values: rlb[1] (previous bar) determines base direction (positive=up, negative=down), and rlb[0] (current bar) determines if a reversal is occurring (sign change = TO_UP/TO_DOWN transition, same sign = UP/DOWN confirmed). Entry only triggers on confirmed UP/DOWN trend states (not transition states). Pending orders (BUY_STOP/SELL_STOP) are placed at bar[2] high/low with indent and spread adjustments. All existing pending orders are deleted when a new signal fires or when trend transitions occur (TO_UP/TO_DOWN). The RSI uses a very short period (4) with a vertical shift from the 50 level to create a contrarian filter — buying when RSI is below 50-shift during uptrend, selling when RSI is above 50+shift during downtrend.
python_conversion_notes: The RenkoLineBreak custom indicator must be fully reimplemented in Python. Its buffer 2 output encodes trend direction as positive/negative values, with sign changes indicating trend transitions. The EA logic depends on comparing rlb[1] and rlb[0] (previous vs current bar) from this buffer to derive one of 5 trend states (DOWN, TO_DOWN, NO_TREND, TO_UP, UP). Renko box construction requires tick or M1 data to properly build bricks. The pending order placement uses bar[2] high/low (3 bars back from current, since CopyHigh starts at index 1 with count 3 giving bars [1],[2],[3] mapped to high[0],high[1],high[2]) as trigger prices. The indent and spread adjustments on open/stop prices must be carefully replicated. The RSI contrarian filter (entering against RSI direction within a trend) is unusual and must be preserved exactly. New-bar guarding uses datetime comparison via CopyTime. The MM_MODE enum and MoneyFixedLot.mqh include suggest planned but unimplemented percentage-based sizing — only fixed lots via InpVolume are used in the actual OrderOpen call.
